@21f3000759 @Mrinal.exe @22f3000671 @hemalatha @Subendu

Sir/Madam,
Will multiline matching using sed and sed flow control be asked in OPPE ?

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked:
flow control – while good to know and handy, will not be directly tested in OPPE.
However, if you know flow control, you might be able to construct a solution using that for the OPPE question on sed. However, that is not the only solution, and non-flow solutions exist. Multiline matching will not be asked.
